responsibility: This definition module declares Logitech-compatible fixed-buffer string utilities for GNU Modula-2. It defines procedures for assignment, insertion, deletion, substring search and copy, concatenation, length, and three-way comparison over ARRAY OF CHAR values, providing a legacy string-manipulation API separate from the newer DynamicStrings module.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the Strings pair: it exposes the fixed-buffer string utility API, while Strings.mod provides the concrete operations using StrLib and DynamicStrings.
